Problem Statement:
Given a number N and an array of N elements, find the Bitwise OR of the array elements. 
Input Description:
Input Size : N <= 100000 
Output Description:
The output is the Bitwise OR of the array elements. 
Sample Input:
2
2 4 
Sample Output:
6
